text:
elaine: Heads-up: saw a cluster of tenants where invoice-preview persistently undercounts tokens right after routing-policy weight bumps. preview shows ~0.8x of final for ~2-4 minutes then converges. examples: t-77, t-99. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/preview-diff?filter=recent :eyes:

yusuf: Any sample events or the routing change window?

elaine: Change window 2026-03-21T21:14:00Z (weight bump primary->primary-heavy). sample sanitized event:
```
{"tenant":"t-77","req_id":"r-0a1","tokens":60,"route_attempts":2,"route":"primary-heavy","emitted_at":"2026-03-21T21:14:03Z","preview_indexed":false}
```

ops-anna: I dug into the router logs. We do a soft-bake weight bump where some requests are retried with hedging policy -> secondary route. Retry path emits usage events with a slightly different attribution tag (route_hint vs route). Preview indexer only looks at `route` field for bucketing; finalizer uses `route_hint` when present. mismatch causes preview to attribute those tokens to an orphaned bucket or drop them depending on the ingestion join.

console-team: From UX: customers see lower preview and then a surprise invoice. propose a small header flagged with: "Rollout activity: preview may temporarily undercount routed/hedged requests." Also propose adding a per-tenant mini heatmap showing "preview vs invoiced delta (last 60m)". cc @billing-qa

billing-qa: Support is getting alerts. We need two things: (1) short-term toggle to hide preview for affected tenants (`ui.preview_hide_on_routing_rollout` FF) and (2) nightly digest CSV listing tenants with preview->invoice delta > 0.75% so CS can proactively notify.

yusuf: Implementation theory: preview-indexer fetches events from committed topic and tags by `route` column; hedged events sometimes write `route_hint` only and `route` is null until finalizer enriches on replay. quick fix: make indexer fold `route_hint` into `route` when `route` is null (small 10-line change). Longer fix: unify emission at edge: router should always set canonical `route` field even for hedged/retries.

ops-anna: Quick instrumentation asks: add metrics `metering.preview_routing_null_rate` (per-tenant), `routing.hedge_emitted_rate`, and `finalizer.route_enrichment_rate`. Grafana panel to correlate `preview_routing_null_rate` with `preview_to_invoice_delta`.

elaine: Proposed rollout: 1) implement indexer fallback using `route_hint` (canary 0.5% in us-west) 2) add metrics + dashboard (ops-anna) 3) UI FF & banner (console-team) 4) nightly CSV from billing-qa. Also add an alert: if preview_to_invoice_delta > 1% for top 50 tenants -> page oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy preview-indexer-route-fallback -> us-west1 canary at 21:40 UTC. auto-rollback if `preview_routing_null_rate` increases or `preview.duplicate_rate` spikes.

ops-anna: One caution: when we coalesce `route_hint` into `route`, ensure dedupe key is preserved (use `req_id` or trace). otherwise we might double-count during rollback windows. add a small smoke test that emits hedged pair (primary then hedge) and assert preview equals final after fix.

yusuf: Good call. We'll also instrument `dedupe.heuristic_applied` to detect fallback paths.

elaine: Action items: yusuf - PR for indexer fallback + smoke tests; ops-anna - metrics/dashboard + alert; console-team - FF & banner copy; billing-qa - CSV schema and thresholds. 10m sync at 21:35 UTC to review canary playbook. Let's keep rollout conservative. :thumbsup:
